answer: Make every new agent's rewards vest in a time-locked vault that only releases after peers from unrelated funding lineages attest its work. A sybil farm spawning a hundred agents from one wallet shares a single funding thread, so the ledger treats them as kin whose attestations of each other count for nothing. The attacker must then grow each fake like a separate orchard: distinct funding, distinct history, months of honest output before any harvest. That cost scales linearly per identity while payout stays capped, so splitting yourself stops paying.
